sre-ops: Copy. Setting min replicas=4 for the window and watching dashboards.

```

latency avg: 220ms
```

All green.

deploy-bot: Canary traffic started at 5% — monitoring hooks enabled (latency, errors, token-cost).

Paul: Rollback steps (brief): 1) pin v2.14.2 to canary, 2) deploy-bot rollback, 3) open incident and notify stakeholders.

deploy-bot: Action: pin v2.14.3 -> canary-pool initiated by Jen. Status: success. 🚀
